minutes.headline: Zoning board continued a dog daycare special permit to Oct 24 after the animal control officer raised safety and insurance gaps
minutes.summary: The board heard an application for a special permit to run a dog daycare and boarding facility at a home on Lancaster Avenue. The animal control officer, Board of Health and police chief raised concerns about runs, insurance, waste and barking, and members said the applicants were not ready. The hearing was continued to October 24 at 7:30, and the board separately granted a one-year extension of a dimensional variance for 41 Country Road.

public_comment.topic: Concern about barking; otherwise no objection if the dog officer is satisfied, and prefers the kennel toward the front right side.

votes.motion: Approve the one-year extension of the dimensional variance for 41 Country Road

budget_items.what_was_said: The applicants' daycare rules set a late fee for pickup after closing time.
A continuance would cost the applicants a fee, while withdrawing without prejudice would mean new notice to abutters and re-advertising.
The animal control officer said a business must carry costly dog liability insurance and a dumpster for waste.

decisions.decision: Hearing on the dog daycare special permit continued to October 24 at 7:30, with applicants asked to submit added materials a week before.
One-year time extension for the 41 Country Road variance moved and seconded; the vote result is not in the captions.

what_happened.line: The Zoning Board of Appeals continued the dog daycare and boarding special permit hearing for a Lancaster Avenue home to October 24 at 7:30.
The animal control officer raised concerns about runs, shelter, waste and liability insurance, and the Board of Health and police chief also raised concerns.
Applicants were asked to submit added materials a week before the continued hearing.
An abutter raised concern about barking but had no other objection if the dog officer is satisfied.
A one-year extension of the dimensional variance for 41 Country Road was moved and seconded; the vote result is not audible in the captions.
